self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: After using Elemental Skill (before it hits): ATK +24% for 15s..

en.flavor: This longsword is as silent as the mysterious ocean depths. It is even more ancient than its stylings might imply.

refinements.1: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by <r>12%</r> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of <r>150</r> ATK will be gained based on <r>2.4%</r> of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.
refinements.2: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by <r>15%</r> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of <r>187.5</r> ATK will be gained based on <r>3%</r> of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.
refinements.3: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by <r>18%</r> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of <r>225</r> ATK will be gained based on <r>3.6%</r> of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.
refinements.4: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by <r>21%</r> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of <r>262.5</r> ATK will be gained based on <r>4.2%</r> of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.
refinements.5: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by <r>24%</r> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of <r>300</r> ATK will be gained based on <r>4.8%</r> of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.

fr.flavor: Cette longue épée est aussi silencieuse que les profondeurs mystérieuses de l'océan. Elle est encore plus ancienne que son style ne le laisse supposer.

refinements.1: Libérer une compétence élémentaire augmente l'ATQ de <r>12 %</r> pendant 15 s et accorde un engagement vital d'une valeur équivalant à 25 % des PV max, cet effet pouvant être déclenché une fois toutes les 10 s.
